dataLinkRules: Every new content ID is stable, unique and namespaced; do not overwrite existing story/product IDs.
Only link to known route selectors or IDs present in the current manifest.
Wheel outcomes must remain optional; no outcome is a directive to perform an act or purchase a product.
Concept art must not link to a real sale/checkout until manufacturer, SKU, claims, price, seller, stock, and provider permission are verified.
Keep existing content gated according to current navigation; self-attestation is not formal age verification.
Never infer model identity, anatomy, religious affiliation or relationship from an image.
All new images are local assets; the new gallery makes no external image requests.
